question: In May 20241, the Commission launched a fitness check of EU rules on trade in seal products. To date, only a factual summary report of the public consultation and a call for evidence have been published. This consultation found that 98 % of respondents would not purchase seal products of any kind. Only 3 % of respondents indicated that would consider buying ‘products from hunts intended to protect fishery activities’. 1.
Could the Commission explain why – more than one and a half years later – no detailed fitness check report or Commission staff working document have been forthcoming as yet?
Could the Commission confirm when these documents will be published?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (6.7.2026) The Commission considers that the fitness check of the EU Seals regime1 should be based on a comprehensive, evidence-based assessment which requires some time. The fitness check includes a thorough collection of data, stakeholder consultations, as well as a robust analysis of the data. The Commission intends to publish the results of the fitness check in 2026.
